property_summary: After calling getTokens() once (which distributes value=1000e18), then calling XBornID() which sets balances[owner] = totalDistributed, the reference contract sets balances[owner] to 200001000e18, while the buggy contract subtracts instead of adding, setting totalDistributed to 199999000e18 and thus balances[owner] to 199999000e18.
